symbols.name: coefficient index
symbols.meaning: The index of a coefficient of the convolution.
symbols.quote: Here $k$ is the index of a coefficient of the convolution.

symbols.name: true coefficient
symbols.meaning: The true integer coefficient of the convolution at index k.
symbols.quote: Write $c_k$ for the true integer coefficient at index $k$, and $\hat c_k$ for the value the machine computes for it.

symbols.name: computed coefficient
symbols.meaning: The value the machine computes for the coefficient at index k, which is only approximately an integer.
symbols.quote: Write $c_k$ for the true integer coefficient at index $k$, and $\hat c_k$ for the value the machine computes for it.

relations.predicate: is applied to the output of
relations.quote: Recovery is applied to the output of the [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md), after the known normalizations and digit scales are removed.
Exact recovery is secured by the [Guard-width bound](guard-width-bound.md), which fixes enough extra bits that a single final truncation, discarding those bits, suffices.
Recovery undoes the [phase twist](phase-twist.md) before the coefficients are read, which restores the original cyclic wrap.
